author: graninas
text:
I've decompiled a Java app (a game) to explore its internals.

The code I got is fully obfuscated. Nothing is readable, everything is $$1, $$2 etc.

But I have an LLM. And, oh boy, it sees through the obfuscated code as no human can.

Finally, a task perfectly suited for AI.
